notes.title: Update Announcement for 20250729
notes.content: [p][b][i]1. Optimized multilingual translation for English, Korean, and Japanese;[/i][/b][/p][p][b][i]2. New exclusive behind-the-scenes footage can be unlocked after completing the game with the true ending (completed players need to watch the true ending video again to unlock it);[/i][/b][/p][p][b][i]3. tags.feature: 1. Optimized multilingual translation for English, Korean, and Japanese;
2. New exclusive behind-the-scenes footage can be unlocked after completing the game with the true ending (completed players need to watch the true ending video again to unlock it);

tags.bug: 3. Fixed some typos and issues with audio and video synchronization.

notes.title: 20250629 Update Announcement
notes.content: [p][i]1. Fixed the issue where the male lead's voice remained on the map interface even when the male lead's voice was turned off;[/i][/p][p][i]2. Fixed the issue where there was a probability of not being able to exit after the crowdfunding gratitude list was played;[/i][/p][p][i]3. Fixed known spelling errors;[/i][/p][p][i]4. Fixed the issue of abnormal completion status display during the second exploration of the table;[/i][/p][p][i]5. Optimized the display status of the map;[/i][/p][p][i]6. Optimized the display status of some UI;[/i][/p][p][i]7. The overall difficulty has been slightly reduced.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]*Thank you for your feedback, players. If you still have any other questions or suggestions, please feel free to let us know through various channels. Thank you again for your support![/p]

tags.bug: 1. Fixed the issue where the male lead's voice remained on the map interface even when the male lead's voice was turned off;
2. Fixed the issue where there was a probability of not being able to exit after the crowdfunding gratitude list was played;
4. Fixed the issue of abnormal completion status display during the second exploration of the table;

tags.balance_change: 7. The overall difficulty has been slightly reduced.
